caseNameFull: Monge v. Smyth, Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Wareham C. Seaman for petitioner. Solicitor General Sobeloff, Assistant Attorney General Rice and Hilbert P. Zarky for respondent.

opinions.text:
Appeal from and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. The petition for writ of cer-tiorari is denied.
